1. [main.nim:3971 / StateTransitionEngine.execute] — Compile error: h.modelStep() is called without the required step: JsonNode argument.
2. [main.nim:158-159 / openStore] — Runtime resource error: a non-null SQLite handle returned on sqlite3_open_v2 failure is not closed before the exception is raised.
3. [main.nim:178-195 / bindParams] — Database error: all sqlite3_bind_* return codes are discarded, so parameter-binding failures are silently ignored.
4. [main.nim:273-282 / getJson] — Logic/data-integrity error: malformed persisted JSON is silently replaced by {} or the fallback value, hiding database corruption and changing state.
5. [main.nim:362-370 / migrate] — Migration error: every CatchableError from the chat_jobs ALTER statements is swallowed, including genuine migration failures unrelated to an already-existing column.
6. [main.nim:428-435 / migrate] — Migration error: every CatchableError from the knowledge_docs ALTER statements is swallowed, allowing startup with an incomplete schema.
7. [main.nim:617-643 / textEmbedding] — Simulated-content error: the purported embedding is a deterministic hashed bag-of-words vector rather than a semantic model embedding.
8. [main.nim:819-856 / safeJoin] — Sandbox logic error: tenant is joined into the workspace path before validation, so a tenant value containing traversal components can move the sandbox base outside WorkspaceRoot.
9. [main.nim:1070-1073 / ensureKnowledgeRepo] — Tenant-isolation error: non-injective tenant sanitization lets distinct tenant IDs map to the same knowledge repository.
10. [main.nim:1086-1091 / commitKnowledgeDoc] — Data-corruption error: non-injective category/slug sanitization lets distinct knowledge documents resolve to the same filesystem filename and overwrite one another.
11. [main.nim:1216-1246 / validateOutboundHost] — SSRF logic error: hostnames are never DNS-resolved and checked before connection, so a hostname resolving to a private/loopback address passes validation.
12. [main.nim:1756-1762 + main.nim:3629-3638 / httpRequestAsync,http_fetch] — SSRF logic error: only the initial URL is validated while HTTP redirects are followed without validating each redirect destination.
13. [main.nim:1758 / httpRequestAsync] — Runtime/liveness error: the HTTP client timeout is set to -1, allowing an upstream request to hang indefinitely.
14. [main.nim:1762 / httpRequestAsync] — Runtime/memory error: response bodies are buffered without a size bound, allowing arbitrarily large upstream responses to exhaust memory.
15. [main.nim:1248-1265 / readBoundedBody] — Stub/dead-path error: the implemented bounded-body reader is never used, so its response-size protection has no effect.
16. [main.nim:1863-1866 / parseOpenAiResponse] — Simulated-content error: missing token usage is replaced with fabricated token counts derived from content.len div 4.
17. [main.nim:1946-1972 / geminiCall] — Logic/type-state error: Gemini usage JSON is retained, but promptTokens, completionTokens, and totalTokens are never populated and remain zero.
18. [main.nim:2077-2085 / invokeModel] — Accounting logic error: ordinary model invocations do not call chargeTokens, so almost all LLM consumption is absent from tenant/task token accounting.
19. [main.nim:2087-2088 / apiKey] — Dead placeholder error: the API-key helper is never used.
20. [main.nim:2090-2097 / defaultAgentKey] — Dead authentication-placeholder error: the generated/default agent credential is never used by request authentication.
21. [main.nim:2099-2100 / enforcePromptBound] — Stub error: prompt bounding is explicitly a no-op.
22. [main.nim:2102-2104 / effectiveMaxTokens] — Placeholder logic error: source is discarded and the function performs no effective token-limit policy.
23. [main.nim:2106-2112 / chargeTokens] — Budget logic error: tenant.token_budget is never read or enforced; token use is always accepted.
24. [main.nim:2121 / callChatCompletionsAsync.maxTokens] — Logic error: the caller-supplied maximum-token value is discarded.
25. [main.nim:2122 / callChatCompletionsAsync.temperature] — Logic error: the caller-supplied temperature is discarded.
26. [main.nim:2123 / callChatCompletionsAsync.logprobs] — Logic error: the caller-supplied logprobs request is discarded.
27. [main.nim:2124 / callChatCompletionsAsync.topLogprobs] — Logic error: the caller-supplied top-logprobs count is discarded.
28. [main.nim:2125 / callChatCompletionsAsync.echoPrompt] — Logic error: the caller-supplied echo-prompt setting is discarded.
29. [main.nim:2126 / callChatCompletionsAsync.topP] — Logic error: the caller-supplied top-p value is discarded.
30. [main.nim:2155 / recursiveReasonCall] — Accounting logic error: recursive reasoning charges tokens with an empty task ID, so the task’s token counter is not updated.
31. [main.nim:2161-2168 / recursiveReasonCall] — Recursion logic error: every recursive child is called with branches=1, which makes the recursion condition fail at the next level and prevents the configured deeper recursive tree.
32. [main.nim:2228-2254 / runTokenLevelDistillation] — Simulated-functionality error: teacher/student calls do not request token logprobs, so aligned token windows remain empty and the claimed token-level reverse-KL distillation falls back to a fixed synthetic magnitude.
33. [main.nim:2273-2274 / haltForBudget] — Stub error: the budget-halting function explicitly does nothing.
34. [main.nim:2370-2407 / pruneSigma] — Dead logic error: the state-pruning routine is never called, so the limits it defines for model context, queues, facts, blockers, handoffs, and subgoals are never enforced.
35. [main.nim:1386,4259-4262,4301 / maxSteps] — Logic error: max_steps is stored and restored but never checked during execution, so configured step limits have no effect.
36. [main.nim:1676-1699 / normalizePlanStep.status] — Plan-integrity error: arbitrary model-supplied string statuses are accepted instead of enforcing a valid initial status, allowing steps to arrive already "completed" or otherwise become unrunnable.
37. [main.nim:1695-1696 / normalizePlanStep.depends_on] — Type-validation error: a present depends_on value of the wrong type is silently replaced by an empty dependency array instead of being rejected.
38. [main.nim:2771-2775 / currentPlanStep] — Type-validation error: non-string dependency entries become an empty ID and are silently skipped, bypassing the malformed dependency.
39. [main.nim:2646-2708 / routeDecisionFromJson.plan] — Plan-graph error: initial plans are not checked for duplicate step IDs.
40. [main.nim:2646-2708 / routeDecisionFromJson.depends_on] — Plan-graph error: initial plans are not checked for dependencies referencing nonexistent step IDs.
41. [main.nim:2646-2708 / routeDecisionFromJson.depends_on] — Plan-graph error: initial plans are not checked for self-dependencies.
42. [main.nim:2646-2708 / routeDecisionFromJson.plan] — Plan-graph error: initial plans are not checked for dependency cycles.
43. [main.nim:2821-2858 / replaceRemainingPlan] — Plan-graph error: replacement plans validate IDs but do not reject self-dependencies.
44. [main.nim:2821-2858 / replaceRemainingPlan] — Plan-graph error: replacement plans do not detect dependency cycles.
45. [main.nim:2788-2804 / setStepStatus] — Ambiguous-plan error: duplicate IDs update only the first matching plan step, making status/progress behavior inconsistent when an initial route contains duplicates.
46. [skills/builtin-llm-models/SKILL.md:44 / graph consistency claim] — Fake/broken-reference error: the reference skill states that backend graph consistency is validated, while the backend does not validate self-dependencies or dependency cycles.
47. [main.nim:2860-2866 + main.nim:3724-3742 / ToolSpec.schema] — Fake-schema error: registered argument schemas are descriptive metadata only; tool arguments are never validated against them before handler execution.
48. [main.nim:3183-3193 / vm_upload_file] — Sandbox/security error: the tool accepts an arbitrary backend-visible local_path, allowing agent-controlled reads of files outside the task workspace.
49. [main.nim:3191 / vm_upload_file] — Runtime/memory error: the entire selected backend file is loaded and base64-encoded without a size limit.
50. [main.nim:3199-3208 / vm_download_file] — Runtime/memory error: the entire VM file is base64-transferred and decoded in memory without a size limit.
51. [main.nim:3211-3215 / vm_download_file.name] — Path-traversal error: the agent-controlled output name is joined directly to the artifact directory, so ../ components can escape that directory.
52. [main.nim:3113-3138 / document extraction PDF path] — Fake/incomplete-content error: the tool advertises complete readable document extraction but PDF processing only extracts the PDF text layer, omitting readable image/scanned content.
53. [main.nim:3113,3140-3141 / document extraction DOCX path] — Fake/incomplete-content error: DOCX extraction reads only word/document.xml, omitting readable headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes, comments, and other package parts.
54. [main.nim:3113,3143-3152 / document extraction PPTX path] — Fake/incomplete-content error: PPTX extraction only collects slide shape text and omits readable notes and other presentation content.
55. [main.nim:3113,3155 / document extraction XLSX path] — Ambiguity/logic error: XLSX is loaded with data_only=False, returning formulas rather than cached displayed results despite the tool’s readable-content contract.
56. [main.nim:3416-3421 / memory_search] — Tenant-isolation error: memory search uses defaultTenantId instead of the task’s tenant ID.
57. [main.nim:3430-3436 / memory_write] — Tenant-isolation error: memory writes use defaultTenantId instead of the task’s tenant ID.
58. [main.nim:3432 / memory_write.slug] — Path-traversal error: the model-controlled slug is appended to knowledgeRoot without sandboxing or sanitization, allowing ../ traversal.
59. [main.nim:3674-3678 / subAgentSystem] — Prompt-construction error: subagent_core is inserted twice into every generated subagent system prompt.
60. [main.nim:3687-3691 / buildStepMessages] — Tenant-isolation error: learned policy, skills, and knowledge are loaded from defaultTenantId instead of h.tenantId.
61. [main.nim:3724-3742 / executeToolAction] — Authorization error: h.allowedTools is never checked, so any registered tool can execute regardless of the task/tenant allow-list.
62. [main.nim:3753,3777 / modelStep invalid-output path] — Runtime state-machine error: malformed model output attempts osAct -> osReflect, but that transition is absent from the orchestrator graph and throws invalid orchestrator transition.
63. [main.nim:3753,3810 / modelStep tool-failure path] — Runtime state-machine error: a failed tool attempts osAct -> osReflect, which is invalid in the orchestrator graph and throws before the intended failure/replan handling completes.
64. [config/prompts.yaml:39-264 + main.nim:3744-3826 / Gemini step protocol] — Broken-contract error: the Gemini prompt requires an {"images":[...]} response while root modelStep expects action/step_complete, so valid Gemini JSON lacks the completion field needed by the root step protocol.
65. [main.nim:3766-3767 / Gemini modelStep fallback] — Fake-success error: unparseable Gemini output is fabricated into step_complete=true and treated as successful visual completion.
66. [main.nim:3826-3831 / modelStep] — Verification logic error: a plan step is marked completed solely from model-controlled step_complete=true plus tool success, with no backend verification of the step goal.
67. [main.nim:3927-3961 / finalizeTask] — Dead verification error: finalizeTask, the path that runs deterministic terminal verifiers and required_files checks, is never called by normal task execution.
68. [main.nim:3941-3955 / finalizeTask] — Verification logic error: even when deterministic terminal verification fails, a positive semantic completion response overrides it and marks the task verified=true and succeeded.
69. [main.nim:3963-3964 / StateTransitionEngine.execute] — Stub error: the StateTransitionEngine argument itself is discarded, so execution does not use the engine instance.
70. [main.nim:1488 / StateTransitionEngine.maxRetries] — Dead configuration error: maxRetries is initialized to 3 but never used.
71. [main.nim:4000 + main.nim:4165-4166 / initial system1Tick] — Deterministic runtime error: System1 runs before initial System2 routing, finds no plan step, calls completionCheck, and attempts invalid osPerceive -> osValidate.
72. [main.nim:4017-4029 / completionCheck] — Verification logic error: complete=true is accepted without requiring a criteria array corresponding to the configured completion criteria.
73. [main.nim:4021-4026 / completionCheck] — Fake-verification error: when the evaluator returns complete=true, every checklist entry is forcibly rewritten to "satisfied" regardless of its individual evaluator result or evidence.
74. [main.nim:4165-4178 / system1Tick success path] — Verification logic error: normal successful completion directly sets verified=true and succeeded without running verifyTerminal, so configured deterministic verifiers and required files are bypassed.
75. [main.nim:4100-4105 / system2Think.cognition] — Type-validation error: the promised 16-number cognition vector is only padded/truncated by length; element numeric types are never validated.
76. [main.nim:4251-4264 / createTask.allowedTools] — Authorization logic error: new tasks receive every registered tool instead of the tenant’s persisted allowed_tools.
77. [main.nim:4273-4303 / restoreTask.allowedTools] — Authorization logic error: restored tasks receive every registered tool instead of restoring the tenant’s persisted allowed_tools.
78. [main.nim:1433,4268,4307 / activeTasks] — Runtime memory-leak error: terminal task handles are inserted into activeTasks but never removed.
79. [main.nim:1439,4406,4479 / activeSubAgents] — Runtime memory-leak error: terminal subagent handles are inserted into activeSubAgents but never removed.
80. [main.nim:4496-4591 / subAgentSupervisor] — Runtime/liveness error: the subagent loop has no iteration, time, step, or budget termination bound and can run indefinitely.
81. [main.nim:4529,4532,4556,4585 / subAgentSupervisor.messages] — Runtime/context-growth error: subagent conversation history grows without pruning and the entire history is repeatedly sent to the model.
82. [main.nim:4566-4583 / subAgentSupervisor] — Fake-verification error: model-controlled done=true immediately marks the subagent succeeded without backend verification of the delegated goal.
83. [main.nim:4616-4624 + main.nim:4498-4503 / stopping subagent launch] — State logic error: a persisted stopping subagent is launched and the supervisor unconditionally changes it to "running" and emits "started" before checking stopRequested.
84. [main.nim:4629-4637 / selectedSubAgentIds.agent_ids] — Deadlock error: explicit agent_ids are not filtered against _actor_agent_id, so a subagent can wait for itself.
85. [main.nim:4641-4644 / selectedSubAgentIds scope=task] — Deadlock error: task scope includes the calling subagent itself, so a subagent invoking wait_subagents with task scope waits for its own termination while blocked inside that wait.
86. [main.nim:4674-4695 / waitSubAgentsTool] — Runtime/liveness error: waiting has no timeout or cancellation check, so a nonterminating child can block the caller indefinitely.
87. [main.nim:4876-4880 / diagnosticAllowedTools] — Fake authorization error: the tenant ID is explicitly discarded and the diagnostic allow-list returns all registered tools.
88. [main.nim:4882-4883 / runDiagnosticRolloutCase.candidateOverride] — Simulated-diagnostic error: the candidate skill override is explicitly discarded, so the regression gate’s candidate run does not execute or evaluate the candidate being considered.
89. [main.nim:5156-5161 + main.nim:2700-2701 / routeNeedsExecution] — Dead-branch logic error: every valid route is required to contain a nonempty plan, and every nonempty plan forces execution, making the simple-specialist/direct route impossible.
90. [main.nim:5202 / directChat routed completion] — Accounting error: routed chat completions return an empty usage object instead of the model usage consumed by the task.
91. [main.nim:5195-5204 / directChat] — Runtime/liveness error: routed synchronous chat waits forever if the created task never reaches succeeded, failed, or halted.
92. [main.nim:5242 / streamRequestyJob] — Runtime/liveness error: streaming Requesty requests explicitly use an infinite HTTP timeout.
93. [main.nim:5248-5290 / streamRequestyJob SSE parser] — Streaming parser error: CRLF normalization is performed independently on each network chunk, so a \r\n pair split across chunk boundaries is not normalized and can prevent \n\n event detection.
94. [main.nim:5248-5290 / streamRequestyJob pending buffer] — Streaming parser error: when EOF arrives, any final SSE event remaining in pending without a trailing blank-event separator is discarded.
95. [main.nim:5338-5359 / runChatJob routed execution] — Runtime/liveness error: the chat job polls a routed task indefinitely with no timeout if that task never becomes terminal.
96. [main.nim:5352-5356 / runChatJob routed completion] — Accounting error: routed streaming chat jobs emit an empty usage object, losing the actual task/model token usage.
97. [main.nim:5556-5561 / authenticate] — Authentication stub error: the request is discarded and authentication always returns the default tenant.
98. [main.nim:5722-6054 / handleHttpRequest] — Broken-reference/security error: authenticate is never called, so all exposed API operations execute without request authentication.
99. [main.nim:5563-5568 / ensureDefaultTenant] — Authorization persistence error: every startup overwrites the default tenant’s saved allowed_tools with the complete tool registry.
100. [main.nim:5630 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.maxTokens] — Logic error: the client’s requested maximum-token value is discarded.
101. [main.nim:5631 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.temperature] — Logic error: the client’s requested temperature is discarded.
102. [main.nim:5632 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.topP] — Logic error: the client’s requested top-p value is discarded.
103. [main.nim:5633 / streamChatCompletionsAsync.tenantId] — Tenant-isolation error: the supplied tenant ID is discarded and the generated chat job uses the global default tenant.
104. [main.nim:6111 / newAsyncHttpServer] — Runtime/resource error: maxBody=high(int) effectively removes the HTTP request-body size limit, allowing arbitrarily large request bodies to consume server memory.
105. [main.nim:5930-5940 / task stop endpoint] — State-consistency error: stopping sets sigma.phase="terminal" but does not set h.orchestratorState=osTerminal, leaving the two representations of orchestrator state inconsistent.
106. [main.nim:5951-5965 / task resume endpoint] — Runtime state-machine error: resuming a halted/restored terminal task changes sigma.phase back to "perceive" but does not reset orchestratorState, leaving a restored task in osTerminal where normal routing/execution transitions cannot proceed.
107. [main.nim:5968-5988 / task message endpoint] — Runtime state-machine error: injecting a message clears the route and relaunches failed/halted tasks without resetting orchestratorState, so subsequent rerouting can attempt an invalid transition from the stale state.
108. [main.nim:5930-5940 / task stop endpoint] — Cancellation logic error: stopping the root task does not propagate a stop request to its running subagents, which can continue executing after the root is halted.
    END OF ERROR LIST.
Send back the complete code with all the fixes. Fix each of the listed errors one by one, making sure to actually correct them so that there are 0 errors remaining. Keep the original imports, since the files exist. Write out every single character; do not abbreviate anything. Fix every error. There must be exactly one file. Do not write anything else; just output the complete code, and it must not contain any comments. Never, under any circumstances, use simplified, substitute, dummy, simulated, or fake code. Write the entire file as complete, unabridged, production-ready code in a single code block. It must be 100% error-free, a complete, error-free file, and must be submitted as a downloadable file. These requirements are mandatory and must be strictly adhered to. If no list of errors is provided, you must find all the errors and fix them. If there were comments in the original code, delete them. And most importantly: YOU MUST NEVER SIMPLIFY!
